title: Mass-measure limits of blow-ups of a cone at p are invariant under translations along ℝp
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, all C, C' ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n, ℝ^P := Euclid P), every p ∈ ℝ^P and every sequence λ_j > 0 with λ_j → 0: if C is integer multiplicity and a cone (IsConeCurrent C), and the mass measures of the blow-ups blowUp C p λ_j converge to that of C' (MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp C p λ_j) C'), then for every integer multiplicity representation R' of C' (R' : IMRep univ n with R'.Represents C'), every v ∈ span{p} and every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^P: μ'((· + v)^{-1}(A)) = μ'(A), where μ' := R'.measure = mult·H^n⌞carrier.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C C' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (p : Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsConeCurrent C → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → MassMeasuresConverge (fun j => blowUp C p (lams j) (hlams j).ne') C' → ∀ R' : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, R'.Represents C' → ∀ v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {p}, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R'.measure ((fun x => x + v) ⁻¹' A) = R'.measure A
